status: UNSIGNED DRAFT: nothing here has been run for acceptance
procedure: P1: one-sided Student t(G-1) on the CR1 statistic (reviewer-directed prospective selection, 2026-10-24)

generators.definition: a0: iid N(0,1) G x 16; a1: sqrt(rho) f_g + sqrt(1-rho) z; b0: z * s_g, s = exp(linspace(0, ln scale_ratio, G)); b1: session distribution cycles normal / t3 (unit variance) / centred lognormal sigma 1 (unit variance) by session index mod 3, times s_g; all true mean 0; SplitMix64 Box-Muller normals; drawn in chunks of `chunk` datasets from one stream per cell in the order z, then f (a1) or the chi-square normals (b1)

stop_rules.crash_policy: completed cell files with the same prereg sha256 are kept and skipped on resume; a parameter change is a new declaration
stop_rules.fail_policy: a failed evaluation is recorded; no tuning, no rerun with new seeds under this prereg

decision_rule: overall PASS iff every one of the 27 mandatory evaluations (a0, b0, b1 x G 5, 7, 10 x K 3, 6, 16) has UCB95 <= fwer_target, i.e. count <= k_max(n_per_cell); a1 is reported and is not a criterion; a NaN p counts as p = 1 and any NaN is reported; pass supports calibration under the synthetic regimes only, never a real-data claim; serial dependence is outside the validated domain
